scorecard.rationale: The paper-filtered coffee crossover gives a favorable acute mental-fatigue result after pretest abstinence, with only partial masking. A fortified decaf post-nap comparison supports a similar acute direction. Driving and usual-diet exercise comparisons were inconclusive. Controlled capsule studies report more fatigue after short abrupt restriction and a tiredness benefit after abstention. The 2009 normal-use comparison did not establish the same tiredness response. The 1997 Lane reports and the 2015 intake and intervention records have shared or unresolved lineage. Manualized reduction trials measured total intake or pooled symptoms and did not isolate fatigue. A public account describes delayed fatigue followed by improved restfulness. The weight of evidence leaves minimal easing based on the beverage result, with the size and durability of any effect without withdrawal and in Parkinson disease open. The 39-person soluble-coffee crossover favored caffeinated soluble coffee in exploratory acute comparisons. Enriched versus regular soluble decaf was inconclusive. An additional coffeeberry crossover reported more mental fatigue after 100 mg extract at 60 minutes, with the primary 120-minute and 300 mg comparisons inconclusive. This unroasted fruit product is distant from brewed coffee. It raises uncertainty around general constituent transfer and leaves the limited sign from the beverage unchanged. A separate mechanistic review describes coffee-associated caffeic and chlorogenic acids and their isolated effects in protein-kinase signaling. It gives no independent brewed-coffee or fatigue outcome. The 12-person older-adult caffeine crossover reports higher vigor but an inconclusive fatigue subscale and exertion comparison. A later older-adult performance study measured timed tasks and readiness to invest effort without a dedicated fatigue comparison. The age-stratified mouse study measured isolated muscle power. A separate mouse soleus report gives opposite endurance directions under maximal and submaximal activation, and an earlier recovery protocol gives an inconclusive power result at its lower caffeine concentration. These findings constrain constituent extrapolation. The earlier beverage result remains the basis for the minimal easing lean.
